item.title: Fabrication-Aware Inverse Design of Nanophotonic Devices for 3D Laser-Nanoprinting
item.description: arXiv:2608.16811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advances in 3D laser-nanoprinting enable us to fabricate 3D nanophotonic devices with a wide range of functionalities on demand. item.title: Nonrepeating photonic crystal may enable more tunable, reliable semiconductor lasers
item.description: Over the past two decades, photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers (PCSELs) have shown promise as a type of advanced semiconductor laser useful in defense- and aerospace-related applications. Typically, these devices are made with photonic crystal patterns that repeat across the area of the device.
